note: Human-readable structural contract; this file is not a JSON Schema validator. Examples denote types, not scientific answers.

posterior.json.selection_probability: array[6] of numbers, one P(A|M) per hypothesis
posterior.json.hypothesis_weights: array[6] of numbers, posterior after all six retained records
posterior.json.focal_joint: array[6][32] of numbers, joint P(M,H_0,X_0 | archive), total sum 1

policy.json.second_stage: array[32] of objects {observation_code: integer, added_mask: integer}
policy.json.scenario_risk: object {early: number, late: number, persistent: number}

audit.json.roots: array[10] of objects described below, each initial choice appears exactly once

root_object.added_masks: array of every feasible added mask, in ascending numeric order
root_object.scenarios: object with keys early, late, persistent; each value is a scenario_object

scenario_object.joint_collapse: array[32][number of added_masks], indexed by observation_code then added_masks order
